parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Gokana-street (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1420 | 1.44 | 1.44
2 | 859 | 1.49 | 2.93
3 | 987 | 14.5 | 17.4
4 | 2246 | 33.5 | 50.9
5 | 34337 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HAA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Gokana-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HAA-type
Aquifer depth: 17.4 m – >50.9 m (Layers 4–5: coarse sand/sandstone unit with increasingly high resistivity, 2246–34337 ohm-m)
Recommendation: Target drilling and screen placement within the resistive sand sequence below 17.4 m depth, as the sharp resistivity rise in Layers 4–5 indicates a thick, clean, well-sorted sand/sandstone aquifer with good yield potential; ensure adequate casing through the shallower low-resistivity clayey layers (1–3) to prevent cross-contamination and borehole collapse.
